name: truncation
title: Do not silently truncate large values
lesson: Storing a large value in a smaller type changes the value while the program keeps going.
fix_goal: Check the destination type's range before narrowing.
fix_steps: Compare the requested value with the maximum representable destination value.
Reject the value instead of silently storing the truncated result.
Re-run the lab and confirm the truncated stored value is gone.
